d:
As passive investing surges, massive capital flows into index funds raise fundamental questions about core market mechanics. In this video, we explore whether index funds are quietly distorting stock prices, inflating volatility, and eroding traditional price discovery.
The video discusses why seven out of ten active managers fail to beat benchmark indices, how passive dominance impacts corporate accountability, and what structural imbalances occur when capital concentrates heavily in top-tier stocks versus the broader market.
